name: Cinema Studio
intro: This is Cinema Studio in SmartVideo, where you turn a scene description into cinematic shots using real camera, lens and film look controls.

features.video-image-switch: The switch at the start of the toolbar sets Video or Image. Try a look as a still first, then move to video once you like it.
features.camera-and-lens-controls: Click the summary card to open the camera overlay. Choose a camera, lens and focal length, and each choice becomes plain wording in your prompt.
features.camera-movement: Under Movement in the quick camera builder you can pick moves like dolly in, orbit or handheld to add motion to your shot.
features.film-look: Film Look sets the color and mood in one choice, from natural to moody noir or golden hour.
features.cinema-prompt-builder: The Cinema Prompt Builder lets you type a base scene and read the full compiled wording, so you can edit it before you go further.
features.start-frame-and-end-frame: Attach a start frame to begin from your own picture, and add an end frame too to control exactly how the shot finishes.
features.character-lock: Switch on Character Lock to reuse a stored character reference, which helps keep the same character across your shots.
features.result-screen: On the result screen you can regenerate, download, copy your prompt or link, and finish your shot.

outro: Describe a scene, dial in the camera, and Cinema Studio helps you shape shots that feel like a real production.
